const labelSet = new Set(labels);

const whitelist = [
  "good first issue",
  "codex-reviewed"
];

const blacklist = new Set([
  "do-not-merge"
]);

// Blacklist check
for (const label of blacklist) {
  if (labelSet.has(label)) {
    core.setFailed("PR is Black listed.");
    return;
  }
}

// Whitelist check
let found = 0;

for (const label of whitelist) {
  if (labelSet.has(label)) {
    found++;
  }
}

if (found !== whitelist.length) {
  core.setFailed("PR is missing one or more required labels.");
  return;
}

console.log("✅ PR satisfies label validation.");
